descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S13 A chart that is not yours: not listed, not reachable by URL, not changeable, and no access row can be forged against it

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Every patient access is recorded in the audit log and attributed to the signed-in physician. Each row has the patient, the physician, a timestamp and the action (view / save / generate / handoff send … (UAT OAT-01 step 5; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 7; TFA-94513 AC 12; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U6 Open sign-up: a new email that was never invited signs in with the emailed code. The physician is created and appears in the physician list. (UAT OAT-01 step 6; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 13) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • T4 App review accounts: exactly two designated emails (appconnect-test-account@roundcompanion.com, playstore-test-account@roundcompanion.com) accept a fixed, reusable code that never expires. … (TFA-94513 AC 15; TFA-94513 AC 16; UAT OAT-01 Expected) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Two physicians, each with their own patients in Hospital, clinic and Nursing Home; a signed-in physician and the id of a chart they do not own or that was deleted

When Physician B lists and reads physician A's rounding patient, opens it by URL in the browser, and tries to update and delete it; B does the same for clinic and SNF panels; B calls access.logChartAccess with a chart id B does not own.

Then B's list never shows A's patient, the URL shows no chart, reads return nothing, and updates and deletes are refused and change nothing, in every panel. No PHI_READ row is written for an id B does not own.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): api/isolation.spec.ts, chromium isolation.spec.ts and api/audit.spec.ts assertions. Judged against U6 (open sign-up lets anyone in, so a new account must not see another physician's patients), T4 (an account sees only its own patients, in both modes; …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S13

A chart that is not yours: not listed, not reachable by URL, not changeable, and no access row can be forged against it

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-01.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/audit.spec.ts [api] — chart-access logging cannot be forged against someone else's chart — expected
  • api/isolation.spec.ts [api] — a rounding patient is invisible to another physician — expected
  • api/isolation.spec.ts [api] — another physician cannot modify or delete a chart they do not own — expected
  • api/isolation.spec.ts [api] — clinic and SNF panels are isolated the same way — expected
  • isolation.spec.ts [chromium] — another physician's patient is absent from the list and unreachable by URL — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs, which sign in their own fixture accounts and need the admin key; dev has neither (runner-contract §10), so this runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
